**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/27 (Sat) 02:34
- [FACT] User inquired about the number of medium-sized SMEs in the UK.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated it does not have an exact number for medium-sized SMEs in the UK.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that 99.9% of all businesses in the UK are classified as SMEs, and 99% of these are small businesses employing fewer than 50 people.
- [USER] User offered to provide a table in comma delimited text format.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed it could work with the provided table and requested the user to share it along with instructions on what to do with the information.
- [USER] User provided a table with financial data in comma delimited text format, including sales, costs, gross profit, operating expenses, operating profit, depreciation, amortization, and EBITDA for the years ending 31/03/2019, 31/03/2020, 31/03/2021, and 31/03/2022.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant summarized the financial information from the table, noting the increase in sales, gross profit, operating profit, and EBITDA over the years, as well as the increase in costs, operating expenses, depreciation, and amortization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that the business experienced growth over the period and that the gross profit margin and operating profit margin improved over the years.
- [USER] User asked for the EBITDA margin on 31/03/2021.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained how to calculate the EBITDA margin and provided the calculation: EBITDA of 860,000 divided by Sales of 2,000,000 equals 0.43 or 43%.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that the EBITDA margin on 31/03/2021 was 43%.
- [USER] User thanked the assistant and confirmed the information was correct.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant responded with a welcome message and encouraged the user to ask any other questions.
